proposition.claim:
Recorded check: Lemma3.8's unrestricted time range is false

Recorded check: Lemma3.3(iii) overstates boundedness for the general gamma from part(i)

Recorded check: Remark2.6(i) applies left-tail complementarity to a right-boundary problem

Recorded check: Density representation at t=0 excludes allowed atomic initial measures

Recorded check: Literal reuse of chronological label drivers fails pathwise domination

Recorded check: Martingale derivation contains indicator, factor and terminal-term errors

Recorded check: Imported linear PDE result's explicit coefficient hypotheses are not verified
